cat > /home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-openclawlearner-1792497764/attempts/ff04010ea19b4e2796afd219b7bae1c0/system/state/workspace/programs/task-b5a17c2e.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if not points:
        return out
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points); r1 = max(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points); c1 = max(c for r, c in points)
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            if r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1):
                if grid[r][c] == bg:
                    out[r][c] = 2
    return out
PY
